items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Somehow I got the gig, and I played in Cab Calloway’s show.

ctx.x: You played for a while with the Cab Calloway band?

Well, it was a week. It was a week gig in Boston. That was real early on. I was not yet a senior in high school. I might have been a junior...I might have been 15 years old, putting on a tux of my dad’s that was too big for me. Because I could read music, and I could play changes, so they hired me... Somehow I got the gig, and I played in Cab Calloway’s show. I think I only spoke a couple of words to him all week, but it was pretty exciting being up on the stage with him.
Let’s take you, then, from Mongo Santamaria to your first recordings. I think the first one was called Is, if I’m not mistaken...
